title.narrative: Learning to brave the odds: A specialised empowerment programme for vulnerable adolescent girls living in residential care

description.narrative: EuropeAid/165017/DD/ACT/Multi Page 5 of 41 2 August 2018 Annex A2. Grant application form-Full applicationv (CEDEM)2 The action82.1. Description of the action2.1.1. Description (max 13 pages)2.1.1.1. Relevance of the action to the objectives/sectors/themes/specific priorities of the call for proposalsIn line with the global objective of this call for proposals (i.e. to enable Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) to engage as actors of governance and development at country level) and the objectives of the 2012 EU Communication on Civil Society, this action will increase the capacity of CEDEM to improve its residential care service delivery as per international standards set by the Convention on the Rights of the Child (CRC; United Nations [UN], 1989)9 and the Guidelines for the Alternative Care of Children (GACC; UN, 2010)10. One of the specific priority areas of this call for proposals is gender equality, women's and girls' empowerment and youth inclusion. Hence, this action targets adolescent girls living in residential care, an especially vulnerable group of young people who are at high risk of long-term adverse outcomes such as low educational attainment, unemployment, early or forced marriage/cohabitation, domestic violence, abuse and/or exploitation, teenage pregnancy, homelessness, incarceration, social exclusion or poverty. It is expected that, through the competencies and experience gained with this action, CEDEM will be better able to propose a new model of quality residential care for looked-after adolescent girls and to contribute objectively to local policy dialogues and law-making with regards to alternative care for children.
